title: Per Eric E
content: I was alone at home on a sunny spring day and reading a book. I was under severe stress after a shocking financial loss that threatened to force me to sell our house. I have five kids. The book was about meditation and the vibrations in the universe. I thought it was nonsense and put it down. I closed my eyes, feeling the sun warm my cheek. All of a sudden, I left my body and entered another reality, like going to another dimension. Everything was vibration. I felt an extraordinary sense of love. There, I met other beings who welcomed me and radiated immense love. I felt at home. These beings resembled spiritual figures such as sages, monks, and nuns. They were wise and serene. I felt so cared for, that I didn’t want to leave. Then just as suddenly, I was back in my body. I immediately stood up, looking around my own living room. It felt unreal, like an illusion. The place I had just visited, felt perfectly real. This event profoundly changed me. Before, I identified with my ego and intellect. Now, I see my ego as more of an observer. I instantly knew eternal life was real and death an illusion. I entered a state of grace, feeling deeply loved. I no longer just believed in God, but I became a knower. I simply know we have eternal life. A strong sense of connectedness grew inside me. I felt linked to all people in a deep way, seeing myself in others. I needed to help because they were "us." I started giving my time to those in deep need, donating money and love. I felt powerfully guided by unexplainable synchronicities so intricate that I knew God must be behind them. I’m still guided. I feel deeply that what we call death is actually life itself. It is our source, where we come from and return to. I am not my body.
